facts.quote: I keep the Anchor at Saltby

facts.detail: by Martha Coyle, as every night
facts.quote: I locked the cellar door myself
the best brandy cask was a gallon lighter
was dead drunk in the yard that morning
was as sober as a judge

facts.value: opens off the passage behind the taproom
facts.quote: The cellar door opens off the passage behind the taproom

facts.value: has two keys: Martha Coyle's and Jem Tully's
facts.quote: There are two keys to it
One is on my own ring

facts.detail: night and day, for the morning's barrels
facts.quote: the other Jem carries, night and day

facts.detail: never stirring; the carrier's man had to climb over him to get out
facts.quote: He was up there before ten and never stirred till six
Ned sleeps in the loft over the stable, across the yard
Jem sleeps on the settle in the passage, from ten until I come down at six

facts.value: gives up his key, and the money with it
facts.quote: He gave it up, and the money with it

facts.value: sells a gallon of brandy to the carrier's man
facts.quote: he had sold a gallon to the carrier's man at midnight

facts.value: stands Ned Sharp a mugful, so that Martha Coyle should look no further than the yard
facts.quote: stood Ned a mugful at dawn
